angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 372,895 km at 52.34 pc = 0.1 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 19.1058 +/- 0.0201 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 52.34 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.536 +/- 0.001 solar radii from Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of LP 714-47 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract): 372,895 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.542 +/- 0.001 solar masses from Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of LP 714-47 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4123 +/- 44 K from Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of LP 714-47 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of LP 714-47 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/lp-714-47.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.714, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 714-47 (pscomppars): spectral type M1 V, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 714-47 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.05 dex, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 714-47 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.12494, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 714-47 (pscomppars): age 2.9 Gyr, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 714-47 (pscomppars): rotation period 28.6 d, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of LP 714-47 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
